name: README.md
html:
luiskr.com V3 — desktop

The Electron shell — wraps the built site+CMS as an installable desktop app.

Rather than file:// (which would break service workers, module preloads, and Firebase OAuth), the app serves dist/ over an ephemeral 127.0.0.1 port so everything runs on a real http origin — the same behavior as yarn preview.

The media-convert API is intentionally not proxied: it exists only under yarn dev's Vite middleware, so the converter panel behaves exactly like a non-dev browser (the localhost gate hides it).

Files

FileWhat it does
main.mjsElectron main process — serves dist/ on a local port, loads the site.
launcher-main.mjsLauncher window — a small GUI for yarn setup/dev/verify/build so common operations are one click.
launcher.htmlThe launcher's renderer page.
preload.mjsContext-isolated preload — exposes a namespaced API for command + streamed output without node integration.
electron-builder.ymlelectron-builder config — per-OS installers (dmg/nsis/AppImage).
package.jsonThe desktop:dev / desktop:build scripts.

Commands

yarn desktop:dev      # open the built site in an Electron window
yarn desktop:build    # per-OS installers → release/ (dmg/nsis/AppImage)
yarn setup:gui        # open the setup/run/build launcher GUI

Part of luiskr.com-V3.
